settings.label: FAQs
settings.intro: Answers about orders, delivery, returns, payment and kit.

settings.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.a: Contact us as soon as you can. If your order has not been packed yet we can change or cancel it for you.

settings.q: Do I need an account to order?
settings.a: No. You can check out as a guest. An account lets you track orders and start returns faster.

settings.q: Do your prices include VAT?
settings.a: Yes. Every price on the site includes VAT.

settings.q: How much is delivery?
settings.a: Standard UK delivery is free on orders over £75. Below that it is £4.95.

settings.q: How long will my order take?
settings.a: Most UK addresses get their order in 3 to 5 working days. The Highlands, Islands and Northern Ireland take 4 to 7 working days.

settings.q: How do I track my order?
settings.a: We email you a tracking link as soon as your parcel leaves us. You can also find it in your account.

settings.q: Do you deliver outside the UK?
settings.a: Not at the moment. We deliver to UK addresses only.

settings.q: What if I am not in?
settings.a: The courier will leave a card or message you with options to rearrange delivery or collect your parcel.

settings.q: How long do I have to return something?
settings.a: 14 days from the day your order arrives. Items need to be unused and in their original packaging.

settings.q: Do I pay for returns?
settings.a: Send your return with any tracked service. If something is faulty or we sent the wrong item, we cover the cost.

settings.q: When will I get my money back?
settings.a: Within 5 working days of your return reaching us, back to the card or account you paid with.

settings.q: Can I exchange an item?
settings.a: The quickest way is to return the item and place a new order for the one you want, so you are not waiting on an exchange.

settings.q: Can I return a racket I have played with?
settings.a: We can only accept rackets that are unused, with the protective film still on the face. Not sure which racket suits you? Ask us before you order.

settings.q: Can I pay with Klarna?
settings.a: Yes. Choose Klarna at checkout to split the cost into 3 interest free payments.

settings.q: Does Klarna cost anything?
settings.a: Pay in 3 is interest free. Klarna explains everything, including what happens if a payment is late, before you confirm.

settings.q: Who can use Klarna?
settings.a: Klarna is for UK residents over 18 and is subject to status. Klarna decides at checkout.

settings.q: How do I manage my payments?
settings.a: In the Klarna app or on the Klarna website. You can see what is due and pay early if you want to.

settings.q: Which racket should I start with?
settings.a: A round racket with a soft core. The sweet spot is bigger and it is far easier to control while you learn.

settings.q: What is the difference between round, teardrop and diamond?
settings.a: Round shapes keep the weight low for control. Diamond shapes put the weight in the head for power. Teardrop sits in between.

settings.q: How heavy should my racket be?
settings.a: Most players use a racket between 355 and 375g. Lighter rackets are easier to swing and kinder on the arm.
